title: Planned Maintenance: Sydney to Perth Network Link Fibre Work
current_summary: Planned maintenance is scheduled on one of our network links between Sydney and Perth. The work is optic fibre relocation and repair, and will take place between 12:30 AM and 6:30 AM AEDT on Thursday 19 November 2026. Some internet services in NSW and WA may be affected for up to 6 hours during this window. Traffic is normally rerouted over other paths, so you may notice slower speeds rather than a complete loss of service.

cause.reason: Planned optic fibre relocation and repair work on the Sydney to Perth network link, carried out by an upstream network provider.

updates.content: We have been advised of planned maintenance on one of our network links between Sydney and Perth. The work involves relocating and repairing optic fibre and is scheduled between 12:30 AM and 6:30 AM AEDT on Thursday 19 November 2026. Some internet services in NSW and WA may be affected for up to 6 hours during this window. We expect traffic to reroute over other paths, so any impact is more likely to be reduced performance than a complete loss of service. We will post an update if anything changes.
